objective: train a donor-aware PBMC cell-type and IFN-state representation and test cell-type transfer on a distinct laboratory and dataset without cell-level split leakage

training_and_donor_holdout.expected_design: eight donors with paired control and six-hour IFN-beta PBMC single-cell RNA-seq

pristine_external_lab_cell_type_holdout.expected_design: PBMC1 and PBMC2 experiments measured by multiple scRNA-seq methods

independent_IFN_direction_confirmation.expected_design: three donor-paired unstimulated versus six-hour IFN-alpha monocyte samples

forbidden_label_authority: labels predicted by the model being evaluated
clusters created after inspecting external expression
manual relabeling chosen to improve external accuracy
ambiguous_or_unmapped_label_policy: exclude before feature loading and report every excluded label and count
fallback_if_released_donor_ids_differ: sort the eight author donor identifiers lexically; first six fit, seventh calibration, eighth sealed test; record that fallback before model fitting

feature_contract.normalization: per-cell library size to 10000 followed by log1p
feature_contract.gene_alignment: exact case-sensitive HGNC symbol intersection only
feature_contract.feature_selection: fit-donor variance only; top 512 genes after excluding mitochondrial and ribosomal-prefix genes

model_contract.family: multinomial linear classifier with L2 penalty
model_contract.selection: macro-F1 on fit-donor grouped leave-one-donor-out predictions only
model_contract.calibration: single temperature selected on calibration donor; class-conditional split conformal sets at alpha 0.1

IFN_state_contract.independent_GSE72502_role: direction-only cross-lab confirmation, not a single-cell classifier holdout
IFN_state_contract.GSE72502_primary_test: all three paired donor mean signature differences IFN-alpha minus control are positive

OOD_contract.primary_semantic_OOD: author external labels not admitted by the frozen six-class ontology
OOD_contract.score: one minus maximum calibrated class probability
OOD_contract.if_external_annotations_have_no_unmapped: report semantic OOD unavailable; do not substitute random noise or a post-hoc class

authority.eventual_role: cell-type and IFN-context conditioning before an Aleph sweep, subject to an independently validated observation operator
